cmd:
cd /tmp
UA="Mozilla/5.0 (X11; Linux x86_64) Chrome/120"
date -u
curl -s -m 20 -A "$UA" -o deco.html -w "decobufr http=%{http_code} bytes=%{size_download}\n" "https://www.ogimet.com/cgi-bin/decobufr?file=20261005152226_ISID10_UKMS_051500.bufr"
echo "--- subset markers"; grep -o 'subset_[0-9]*' deco.html | sort -u | head -20 | tr '\n' ' '; echo
echo "--- button/onclick samples"; grep -o -i '<button[^>]*>' deco.html | head -3; grep -o -i 'onclick="[^"]*"' deco.html | head -3
echo "--- around Odesa"; python3 - <<'PY'
import re
t=open("/tmp/deco.html",encoding="utf-8",errors="replace").read()
i=t.find("Odesa")
print(t[max(0,i-900):i+700] if i>=0 else "NO ODESA")
PY
echo "--- getbufr help (text)"; sleep 2
curl -s -m 20 -A "$UA" "https://www.ogimet.com/getbufr_help.phtml.en" | python3 -c "
import sys,re,html
t=sys.stdin.read(); t=re.sub(r'<script.*?</script>|<style.*?</style>','',t,flags=re.S); t=html.unescape(re.sub(r'<[^>]+>',' ',t)); t=re.sub(r'\s+\n','\n',re.sub(r'[ \t]+',' ',t))
print(t[:3500])"
echo "--- getbufr list guess"; sleep 2
curl -s -m 20 -A "$UA" -w "\nhttp=%{http_code}\n" "https://www.ogimet.com/getbufr.php?res=list&beg=202610051400&end=202610051600&ind=UKMS" | head -c 900
